mission: Match ready orders to available couriers and recover disrupted deliveries.
why_it_exists: A shared fleet needs one consistent assignment decision.
design_decisions: Batch assignment accounts for travel and lateness.
Recovery proposals go through validated tools and A2A.
known_limits: Travel and demand are simulated, not live traffic predictions.

tool_descriptions.dispatch.assign: Assign a feasible courier and route to a basket.
tool_descriptions.dispatch.complete: Record completion only after physical arrival.
tool_descriptions.dispatch.defer: Defer dispatch until capacity becomes available.
tool_descriptions.dispatch.read: Read delivery candidates and physical fleet state.
tool_descriptions.memory.read: Recall evidence inside the current run, role and order scope.
tool_descriptions.memory.write: Append a bounded memory observation with provenance.
tool_descriptions.queue.publish: Publish an allowed topic to a permitted recipient.
